name: Mikage Ran
source:
She is sexually obsessed with Karena, and her obsession extends to the main character who gets caught up in the commotion.

She fights with a mixed style that she learned through modern training by a top-level staff team.  Her striking, indirect and submission techniques are all top-notch.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150203020610/http://www.5bit.net/WFG.html]archived official site[/url]]
